defect: a refused retraction was reported as a phantom event position (`at seq None`) on the event channel, the operator's line leaked Rust debug formatting, and the retraction's reason shared the event channel's blocked_error — the operator could not tell which queue was stuck
method: the same scenario against the published v0.7.32 release asset and against the fixed tree: a journal with one held event and three planted retractions, against a receiver process that answers events and refuses retractions with http 404; the faces must be RED on the published asset and GREEN after, the guards GREEN on both
rule: the retraction queue is its own channel: an event is held at a seq, a retraction at a reorg id
a blocked retraction is named as a retraction — the operator's line says which queue is stuck and at which id
the retraction's reason travels on its own field; one queue's reason is never read as the other's
a refused retraction is never quarantined: a late retraction costs money, so that queue stays blocked

faces.claim: the operator's line names the RETRACTION channel and the reorg id, and never prints a non-existent event position

observed.stderr: reeflog: 1 target(s) blocked — delivery is at-least-once and in order, so the queue stops at the first failure; the failure is recorded, not swallowed | reeflog: blocked — t1 at seq None: refused with http 404

reeflog: 1 target(s) blocked — delivery is at-least-once and in order, so the queue stops at the first failure; the failure is recorded, not swallowed | reeflog: blocked — t1 at reorg 1: refused with http 404 — the RETRACTION is still owed, the consumer has not been told that the chain unmade it

faces.claim: the operator's line carries no Rust debug formatting

observed.stderr: reeflog: 1 target(s) blocked — delivery is at-least-once and in order, so the queue stops at the first failure; the failure is recorded, not swallowed | reeflog: blocked — t1 at seq None: refused with http 404

reeflog: 1 target(s) blocked — delivery is at-least-once and in order, so the queue stops at the first failure; the failure is recorded, not swallowed | reeflog: blocked — t1 at reorg 1: refused with http 404 — the RETRACTION is still owed, the consumer has not been told that the chain unmade it

faces.claim: the report carries the retraction's reason on its own field; the event channel's error stays null
the report keeps naming the channel facts it already named

guards.claim: an accepted retraction is delivered, receipts and advances the cursor — the fix changes no delivery behaviour
a refused retraction is NEVER quarantined and never skips the cursor (the pre-existing design rule)
the report keeps the queue facts it already carried

summary: published v0.7.32 measured retraction-block-blind (faces 1/4, guards 3/3): the defect faces D1-D3 were red, D4 green; the fixed tree measures retraction-block-named (faces 4/4, guards 3/3); the guards were green on both trees, so the fix names the block and moves no behaviour — a refused retraction is still never quarantined
